title: Lifted Payments Payment Statement Audit Model
description: A processor-neutral, machine-readable model for normalizing monthly merchant payment-processing statements without storing cardholder data. Version 1.1.2 preserves the schema 1.1.0 contract and hardens the validator and publication gate with complete tree inventory, bounded assets, behavioral regression execution, spreadsheet-formula rejection, trusted identity checks, and immutable-tag protection.
notes: All figures and validation vectors are synthetic and do not describe a real merchant. The model contains no cardholder data. The validation report records 2 accepted valid vectors and 14 correctly rejected invalid vectors. Package 1.1.2 preserves the schema 1.1.0 record contract.
